title: Identity security and cryptographic trust boundaries
model: key_reference:string:KMS/HSM key alias, never key material
workflow: Authenticate actor with trusted OIDC federation and validated audience
Resolve institution, branch, role and risk of requested action server-side
Apply step-up authentication and maker-checker where transaction risk requires
Authorize object-level resource and domain command boundaries
Delegate signing/encryption to isolated cryptographic boundary with audited key alias
Record access, policy decision and privilege changes in restricted audit store
requirements: No frontend-only authorization or trust of user-supplied institution identifiers
Do not store raw secrets, private keys, passwords or bearer tokens in app logs or message bus
Separate developers, production operators, security approvers and key custodians
Use approved key rotation, revocation, recovery and compromise procedures
Require expiration and independent review of elevated/break-glass roles
Mask personal identifiers and account data according to approved privacy classification
tests: Wrong audience token cannot reach domain command
Approver and maker cannot be same subject for restricted operation
Expired signing credential blocks production use
Security audit export omits secrets and unapproved personal details
gate: Threat model, institutional IAM/HSM policy, cryptographic review and executed security/access tests.
